### Do the residuals carry structure?

Per-cell residuals over the 6 matched cells (3 templates x 2 directions, paired by template and direction). No top-k anywhere: every statistic below is over all heads.

- `n_sig_fwer` — heads whose |t| beats the 95th percentile of an exact sign-flip max-|t| null (2^6 = 64 flips). With 6 cells the smallest achievable p is 0.016, so 0 means *no head survives correction*, not *the residuals are zero*.
- `frac_heads_6of6_agree` vs `expected_6of6_agree` — reproducibility across cells for the whole population: how often all 6 cells agree on a head's residual sign, against the fair-coin baseline.
- `layer_p_plain` / `layer_p_magnitude_matched` — max per-layer mean |residual| against a whole-grid head shuffle, then against a shuffle restricted to quantile bins of |comp1+comp2|. The stratified one is the claim-relevant test: it holds any monotone bigger-components-bigger-residual dependence fixed and asks whether a particular *depth* is special. See the positive-control table below for its power.
- `moran_p`, `patch_p` — spatial clustering of same-signed residuals on the head lattice. Read `largest_positive_patch` only where the minority sign is sparse: ToM raw is 61.5% positive, so patches percolate (1020 heads, null p95 1032) and the statistic is empty there; it is informative on Gemma raw (8.7% positive) and on both clamped keys.

The code arm is omitted: 2 cells cannot reach p < 0.25.

### Positive control for the layer-localization test

The same test applied to the component fingerprints, which are known to have a late-layer band. Small `p_plain` there = the test can see a band when one exists, so the residual's p-value is interpretable. (The first version of this analysis used the *signed* per-layer mean and returned p = 0.62 on the gC1 fingerprint itself — positives and negatives cancel within a layer. That test was discarded.)

The control validates `p_plain` only. `p_magnitude_matched` is circular here — the strata come from |C1+C5|, so stratifying a component fingerprint removes its own band by construction (hence C1 0.14, C3 0.54). It is non-circular for the residual, which is a different quantity from the sum used to build the strata.
